text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Fenmar Drive, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is recommending that standing be prohibited at all times on the north side of Fenmar Drive between Signet Drive and a point 165 metres east. The proposed amendment will deter parking at this location and will improve vehicle movements for loading and transit operations.
City Council on March 29, 30 and 31, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit standing at all times on the north side of Fenmar Drive, between Signet Drive and a point 165 metres east.
